def dense(matrix):
    return np.asarray(matrix.toarray() if hasattr(matrix,'toarray') else matrix,dtype=np.float64)
def independent_uncertainties(wrapper):
    state=wrapper.model
    cell=np.asarray(wrapper.train_data.obs['cell_type'].astype(str))
    cond=np.asarray(wrapper.train_data.obs['condition'].astype(str))
    donor=np.asarray(wrapper.train_data.obs['replicate'].astype(str))
    delta_errors=[]; beta_errors=[]; summaries=[]
    for i,context in enumerate(wrapper.contexts):
        counts=np.array([[np.sum((cell==context)&(donor==d)&(cond==condition))
                          for condition in ('control','stimulated')] for d in wrapper.donors],dtype=float)
        valid=np.all(counts>0,axis=1)
        n=np.maximum(counts,1)
        w=valid/(1/n[:,0]+1/n[:,1]); w/=w.sum()
        raw_c=state.donor_control_rate[i].numpy(); raw_s=state.donor_stimulated_rate[i].numpy()
        pc=np.clip(raw_c,method.HURDLE_PRIOR,1-method.HURDLE_PRIOR)
        ps=np.clip(raw_s,method.HURDLE_PRIOR,1-method.HURDLE_PRIOR)
        effect=np.log(ps)-np.log1p(-ps)-np.log(pc)+np.log1p(-pc)
        average=(w[:,None]*effect).sum(0)
        between=(w[:,None]*(effect-average)**2).sum(0)/max(1-(w*w).sum(),1e-12)
        noise=1/(n[:,0,None]*pc*(1-pc))+1/(n[:,1,None]*ps*(1-ps))
        expected_delta=np.maximum(between-(w[:,None]*noise).sum(0),0)+(w[:,None]**2*noise).sum(0)
        kc=np.rint(n[:,0,None]*raw_c); ks=np.rint(n[:,1,None]*raw_s)
        bn=polygamma(1,kc+.5)+polygamma(1,n[:,0,None]-kc+.5)
        bn+=polygamma(1,ks+.5)+polygamma(1,n[:,1,None]-ks+.5)
        expected_beta=np.maximum(between-(w[:,None]*bn).sum(0),0)+(w[:,None]**2*bn).sum(0)
        actual_delta=state.detection_uncertainty[i].numpy()
        actual_beta=state.beta_detection_uncertainty[i].numpy()
        de=float(np.max(np.abs(actual_delta-expected_delta)))
        be=float(np.max(np.abs(actual_beta-expected_beta)))
        delta_errors.append(de); beta_errors.append(be)
        assert de<1e-10 and be<1e-8,(context,de,be)
        assert np.isfinite(actual_beta).all() and actual_beta.min()>=0
        summaries.append({'context':context,'delta_max_abs_error':de,'beta_scipy_max_abs_error':be,
                          'delta_quantiles':np.quantile(actual_delta,[0,.25,.5,.75,.95,1]).tolist(),
                          'beta_quantiles':np.quantile(actual_beta,[0,.25,.5,.75,.95,1]).tolist()})
    return {'delta_max_abs_error':max(delta_errors),'beta_scipy_max_abs_error':max(beta_errors),
            'beta_tolerance':1e-8,'contexts':summaries}
